module_summary: AXI-stream to memory DMA: AXI-lite registers configure address/length, stream data buffers through a skidbuffer and FIFO, and a burst planner issues AXI4 write bursts while a busy flag sequences the transfer.

anchors.name: r_busy
anchors.why: Two-state idle/busy controller set by start command, cleared on completion; gates nearly all logic.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TVALID
anchors.why: Incoming stream valid into the stream skidbuffer.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TREADY
anchors.why: Stream ready from skidbuffer, backpressure when FIFO full.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TDATA
anchors.why: Stream payload buffered into FIFO and written to memory.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TLAST
anchors.why: Packet boundary used for TLAST synchronization and overflow check.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: AXI write-address valid issued on each phantom burst start.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: Address channel ready; stalls new burst starts.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Burst start address, advanced by AWLEN+1 per accepted burst.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWLEN
anchors.why: Burst length derived from r_max_burst; updates remaining counters.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Write data valid; with WREADY pops FIFO and decrements counters.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: Write data ready from memory side.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Write data driven directly from FIFO output.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WLAST
anchors.why: Last beat of burst; gates next burst start.

anchors.name: M_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid; retires outstanding bursts and flags bus errors.

anchors.name: M_AXI_BRESP
anchors.why: Write response code; error triggers abort and r_errcode.

anchors.name: axil_write_ready
anchors.why: AXI-lite register write strobe updating command, address, length registers.

anchors.name: awskd_addr
anchors.why: AXI-lite write register index selecting control/address/length word.

anchors.name: wskd_data
anchors.why: AXI-lite write data carrying start/abort/config bits.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RDATA
anchors.why: AXI-lite readback of status, address and length registers.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite read response valid.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_BVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite write response valid.

anchors.name: w_status_word
anchors.why: Packed busy/err/complete/continuous/errcode status word for readback.

anchors.name: cmd_addr
anchors.why: Programmed destination start address; seeds burst address and axi_addr.

anchors.name: cmd_length_w
anchors.why: Programmed transfer length in words; seeds remaining-request counters.

anchors.name: r_continuous
anchors.why: Continuous-mode bit keeping FIFO alive between transfers.

anchors.name: r_increment
anchors.why: Increment versus fixed address mode; sets AWBURST and burst length.

anchors.name: r_err
anchors.why: Error flag from bus error or overflow; triggers abort, blocks restart.

anchors.name: r_errcode
anchors.why: Error code bits: overflow, slave error, decode error.

anchors.name: r_complete
anchors.why: Level completion flag reported in status word.

anchors.name: o_int
anchors.why: Interrupt on transfer completion or continuous-mode overflow.

anchors.name: w_cmd_start
anchors.why: Decoded start command from control register write; sets r_busy.

anchors.name: w_complete
anchors.why: Transfer done when no requests remain and bursts retired; clears busy.

anchors.name: cmd_abort
anchors.why: Latched user abort request (ABORT_KEY write) halting new bursts.

anchors.name: axi_abort_pending
anchors.why: Abort in progress: zeros strobes, stops address and FIFO reads.

anchors.name: zero_length
anchors.why: Length-is-zero flag blocking start command.

anchors.name: phantom_start
anchors.why: Burst-start strobe updating request, outstanding and pending counters.

anchors.name: aw_requests_remaining
anchors.why: Words still to request on address channel, reduced by AWLEN per burst.

anchors.name: aw_bursts_outstanding
anchors.why: Bursts issued awaiting BVALID response.

anchors.name: wr_writes_pending
anchors.why: W-channel beats still to send; drives WLAST.

anchors.name: r_remaining_w
anchors.why: Words remaining on W channel, reported during busy readback.

anchors.name: r_max_burst
anchors.why: Next burst length computed from remaining length and alignment.

anchors.name: initial_burstlen
anchors.why: First burst length considering alignment and fixed mode.

anchors.name: axi_addr
anchors.why: Current W-channel address, advanced per beat for readback/restart.

anchors.name: data_available
anchors.why: FIFO words not yet committed to a burst; gates burst starts.

anchors.name: sufficiently_filled
anchors.why: FIFO holds enough data for next burst; enables phantom start.

anchors.name: aw_none_remaining
anchors.why: No requests remain; gates burst start and completion.

anchors.name: aw_needs_alignment
anchors.why: First burst must be shortened to reach burst alignment.

anchors.name: write_to_fifo
anchors.why: FIFO push when stream beat accepted and TLAST-synchronized.

anchors.name: read_from_fifo
anchors.why: FIFO pop on accepted W beat unless aborting.

anchors.name: fifo_fill
anchors.why: FIFO occupancy used to resync data_available on abort.

anchors.name: fifo_full
anchors.why: FIFO full deasserts stream ready.

anchors.name: sskd_valid
anchors.why: Skidbuffer output valid feeding FIFO write.

anchors.name: sskd_ready
anchors.why: Ready to skidbuffer: FIFO not full and accepting.

anchors.name: tlast_syncd
anchors.why: Stream aligned to packet boundary; gates FIFO writes.

anchors.name: overflow
anchors.why: Stream protocol violation detected; sets error and interrupt.

anchors.name: last_stalled
anchors.why: Prior-cycle stream stall used for overflow check.

anchors.name: new_wideaddr
anchors.why: Address with AXI-lite write strobes merged before loading cmd_addr.

anchors.name: new_widelen
anchors.why: Length with write strobes merged before loading cmd_length_w.

anchors.name: gated_clk
anchors.why: Optional gated internal clock, disabled by default OPT_CLKGATE.

groups.name: Transfer controller
groups.description: Busy/idle sequencing, start/abort handling, error tracking and interrupt generation.

groups.name: AXI-lite register bank
groups.description: Control, address and length registers written and read back over AXI-lite.

groups.name: Stream input FIFO
groups.description: Skidbuffer and synchronous FIFO buffering stream data, TLAST sync and overflow detection.

groups.name: Burst planner
groups.description: Counters computing burst lengths, remaining requests, outstanding bursts and FIFO data availability.

groups.name: AXI4 write master
groups.description: AW/W/B channel registers driving AXI4 write bursts to memory.

groups.name: Clock gating
groups.description: Optional local clock gate active only while busy or bus activity.
